description: Turn a mesh file (STL, OBJ, glTF or GLB, or the tessellated bodies of a STEP AP242 file) into MBEstudio geometry: outline lofts fitted slice by slice, holes as subtracting lofts, and an envelope that is the mesh's bounding box. Without text and owner: { text, report }, where text is the envelope item and the generated body to paste into a part def. With text and owner: the fit written into that part def as one edit (an earlier generated body and the envelope are replaced), { ok, message, text, ops, errors, replacedBody, replacedEnvelope, report }. The report gives the slicing axis, envelope (mm), loft and point counts, and overlap, the mean intersection over union of fitted and true cross sections (1 is perfect).

axis.description: The part axis to slice along; auto tries each and keeps the best.

file_name.description: The file's name; its extension gives the format unless format is set.

max_points.description: Budget of outline points for the body (default 2000); over it the fit coarsens.

origin.description: Part origin: the bounding box centre (default), or the mesh's own origin for a mesh already in the part frame.

owner.description: The part def (qualified or unique name) that gets the body.

step_mm.description: Distance between slices (default 2.5 mm under 90 mm across, else 3).

text.description: A model to write the fit into, with owner.

units.description: Units of the file; auto takes a mesh under 3 units across as metres. glTF and AP242 are metres.

name: fit_mesh
title: Fit a body to a mesh
